article_title: 给工程师分享信息：让上下文可查，让打断有理由
core_theme: 区分信息可获取与立即打断，让工程师既能保持专注，也能自行找到可靠上下文
reader_takeaway: 转发信息前先看状态、工作影响和此刻需要的注意力
summary_angle: 把杂乱消息分流成可查的上下文和一条有理由的打断

final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: accessible engineering context versus immediate interruption. The reader should quickly feel that most information can be stored and found later, while only a few changes deserve to interrupt active work.

Summary angle: a manager routes a pile of message cards into a searchable archive and lets one confirmed decision activate a signal at an engineer's desk.
Narrative flow: before-after. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and three supporting narrative beats, all mapped to the information blocks.
Information blocks:
- Problem: a pile of discussion cards crowds the engineer's workbench.
- Mechanism: most cards go into an indexed archive shelf; visible label 背景.
- Takeaway: one clearly confirmed card activates a single signal lamp beside the focused engineer; visual label 需处理; a small status chip on that card says 已决定.

Main metaphor: a message-routing desk connecting a searchable archive shelf to a signal lamp on an engineer's workbench.
Subject: one manager at the central routing desk, sorting message cards with clear, expressive gestures.
Composition/framing: wide left-to-right contrast. The archive shelf occupies the left side, the routing desk and manager sit in the center, and the engineer continues focused work on the right. Preserve one clear focal point around the single signal lamp and confirmed card.
Style/medium: combine conceptual editorial illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: American cartoon illustration, elastic shapes, clear expressions, bold color fields, light comedic timing. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: warm cream background, deep teal archive furniture, coral red signal accent, charcoal linework. No purple neon.
Visible text policy: allow only three short Chinese labels: 已决定, 背景, 需处理. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: purple neon, screenshots, dashboards, long captions, fake UI, excessive floating cards, generic robot, dark cyberpunk atmosphere.
